blocks.x: Buck wasn't dancing then, too, was he?
he could do is sing. He danced a little bit not much, just a little bit, enough to a tap step No. 8.
What kind of dancing was he doing?
Same kind, tap dancing. He'd do no tap dancing, same -- no different style.
